fields.title: The Night Japan Fills With Frogs
fields.previewText: Micro-season #19 begins with the night sound of frogs rising from Japan’s rice paddies.
fields.subjectVariants:

fields.summary: A reflective English essay on micro-season #19, Frogs Begin to Sing, connecting rice paddies, frog calls, wordplay around kaeru, Basho, and paying attention to seasonal change.
